source: BDB 2025, 2022 regular season, selected tracking weeks
cohort: Non-nullified designed runs with one labeled rusher and 22 players plus ball at a unique snap frame; excludes kneels/spikes/dropbacks. Includes all runner positions.

definitions.coordinates: Offense attacks +x; left plays rotate both axes. LOS and lateral origin use ball at snap. Times use 10 Hz frame IDs.
definitions.frontProxy: Heuristic near-LOS geometry at snap, not a true front call. Over/Under require one attached TE and one outside-guard shade. Overlapping Bear/4i windows become Reduced_ambiguous_proxy; mixed presentations stay ambiguous.
definitions.firstSustainedOlProximity: Same OL/opponent within 1.0 yd for two consecutive 10 Hz frames, first four seconds only. Proximity, not observed hand contact or block success.
definitions.missing: Each metric has its own n. LOS crossings and contact events are censored/missing on some runs; do not zero-impute.
definitions.blockingLabels: Opponent labels are sparse on runs; no run assignments or combo releases are inferred from them.
